name: cta-section
useFor: Use once, as the last section before the footer. `tone="dark"` uses a Fog key on Forest; `light` uses the Forest key and an outlined one. Keep the title to one line.
constraints: A Forest key on the Forest panel
Gradients or photos in the panel
source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): HomeClosing and closing-card.css (the closing window)
title: CTA section
description: The closing card: a large cut panel (Forest, or a Bone frame with a Forest line) with the title, one line, the page's last two actions and a still tick row along its foot.
